lines.hook: Sixty-six on the card. Eight LaLiga goals on the pitch.
stats: Yassir Zabiri has eight in ten games for Racing Santander, the same as Lamine Yamal after ten matchdays.
Three of his goals won games: one in each of Racing's three league wins.
The card was rated on seven goals at Famalicão and forty-two Ligue 1 minutes from the Rennes bench.
lines.contrast: A goal every eighty-two minutes, on a card that gives him sixty-six for shooting.
lines.quote: EA moved his club to Santander. It has not yet moved the number.
lines.close: What would you rate Zabiri? The full read is on scoutgamer.com.
